question: Which single portion is designated as the neck measure and what upward lotus portion follows it?
premises: one part is taken as a unit
that unit is called the neck measure
upward there is a lotus portion called Shiva-part
inference: One part is the neck measure, and upward from it is the lotus, designated as the Shiva-part.
plain_english: One part is the neck measure; upward is the lotus, called the Shiva-part.
